title: [QA] Login Redirection — Valid credentials redirect to /feed [E2E]
precondition: The user is on the login page at app-dev.thehono.com/login
steps: 1. The user enters a valid email and password | 2. The user clicks the Login button
expected:
The application redirects the browser to /feed
The /feed page loads successfully within 5 seconds
edge_cases: The user enters credentials with leading/trailing spaces | The user enters credentials in mixed case | The user clicks Login multiple times rapidly

title: [QA] Login Redirection — Invalid credentials show error and stay on login [NEGATIVE]
precondition: The user is on the login page at app-dev.thehono.com/login
steps: 1. The user enters an invalid email or password | 2. The user clicks the Login button
expected:
The application displays an error message indicating invalid credentials
The user remains on the /login page
edge_cases: The user leaves the email field empty | The user leaves the password field empty | The user enters a password shorter than the minimum length

title: [QA] Login Redirection — Network failure during login [NEGATIVE]
